Fever.description: Fever is a temporary increase in body temperature, often due to infection.
first_aid: Drink plenty of fluids to prevent dehydration.
Use a cool compress on the forehead.
prevention: Avoid close contact with sick people.
Fever.disclaimer: ⚠️ This is general information, not a medical diagnosis. Please consult a doctor if fever persists.

Cold.description: The common cold is a viral infection affecting the nose and throat.
prevention: Avoid touching your face with unwashed hands.
Cold.disclaimer: ⚠️ Usually mild, but if symptoms last more than 10 days, seek medical advice.

Flu.description: Flu is an infection of the nose, throat, and lungs caused by influenza viruses.
prevention: Maintain hygiene and avoid crowds during flu season.
Flu.disclaimer: ⚠️ Consult a doctor if high fever persists or breathing difficulty occurs.

Cuts.description: A cut is an injury where the skin is broken, often caused by sharp objects.
first_aid: Clean the wound with running water.
Apply gentle pressure with a clean cloth to stop bleeding.
Use antiseptic and cover with a sterile bandage.
Cuts.disclaimer: ⚠️ For deep cuts or uncontrolled bleeding, seek medical attention immediately.

Burns.description: Burns are tissue damage caused by heat, chemicals, electricity, or radiation.
first_aid: Cool the burn under running water for 10-20 minutes.
Cover with a clean, non-fluffy cloth.
prevention: Be careful around hot surfaces and open flames.
Use protective gear while cooking or handling chemicals.
Burns.disclaimer: ⚠️ For severe burns, seek emergency medical care immediately.

Dehydration.description: Dehydration happens when your body loses more fluids than it takes in.
first_aid: Drink water or oral rehydration solutions.
prevention: Drink at least 8 glasses of water daily.
Consume hydrating foods like watermelon and cucumber.
Dehydration.disclaimer: ⚠️ Severe dehydration needs immediate medical care.

Headache.description: Headaches can be caused by stress, dehydration, or underlying illness.
first_aid: Rest in a quiet, dark room.
Use a cold or warm compress.
Headache.disclaimer: ⚠️ Severe or persistent headaches may require medical evaluation.

Anxiety.description: Anxiety is excessive worry or fear that interferes with daily life.
first_aid: Do light physical activity like walking.
Anxiety.disclaimer: ⚠️ If anxiety interferes with daily functioning, consult a mental health professional.

Stress.description: Stress is the body's response to pressure or challenges.
first_aid: Engage in hobbies or activities you enjoy.
Stress.disclaimer: ⚠️ Chronic stress can harm health; seek help if overwhelming.

Back Pain.description: Back pain is discomfort in the back, often from muscle strain or poor posture.
first_aid: Apply a hot or cold pack.
Rest but avoid prolonged bed rest.
Back Pain.disclaimer: ⚠️ Persistent or severe back pain should be checked by a doctor.

Asthma.description: Asthma is a condition where airways narrow and swell, causing breathing difficulty.
first_aid: Seek emergency care if breathing does not improve.
Asthma.disclaimer: ⚠️ Asthma attacks can be life-threatening. Always follow your doctor’s asthma action plan.

Diabetes.description: Diabetes is a condition where the body has trouble regulating blood sugar.
first_aid: Take insulin or medications as prescribed.
Eat balanced meals at regular times.
Diabetes.disclaimer: ⚠️ Diabetes requires long-term medical management. Follow professional medical advice.

Hypertension.description: Hypertension (high blood pressure) increases the risk of heart disease and stroke.
first_aid: Rest and relax in a quiet environment.
Hypertension.disclaimer: ⚠️ High blood pressure is often silent. Regular check-ups are essential.

Allergies.description: Allergies are immune system reactions to substances like pollen, dust, or certain foods.
first_aid: Use an epinephrine injector for severe reactions.
Allergies.disclaimer: ⚠️ Severe allergic reactions (anaphylaxis) require immediate emergency care.

Food Poisoning.description: Food poisoning is caused by eating contaminated food or drinks.
first_aid: Drink oral rehydration solution or water.
Rest and avoid solid food until better.
Seek medical help if severe or prolonged.
prevention: Avoid eating spoiled or street food.
Food Poisoning.disclaimer: ⚠️ Severe dehydration from food poisoning can be dangerous. Consult a doctor if symptoms persist.

Migraine.description: A migraine is a type of headache often accompanied by nausea and sensitivity to light.
first_aid: Rest in a quiet, dark room.
Apply a cold pack on the head.
prevention: Avoid known triggers (stress, lack of sleep).
Migraine.disclaimer: ⚠️ Frequent migraines should be evaluated by a healthcare professional.

Sunburn.description: Sunburn is skin damage caused by overexposure to the sun’s UV rays.
first_aid: Cool the skin with cold water or aloe vera gel.
Drink extra fluids to prevent dehydration.
Sunburn.disclaimer: ⚠️ Severe sunburn with blisters or fever requires medical care.

Insomnia.description: Insomnia is difficulty falling asleep or staying asleep.
first_aid: Avoid caffeine and heavy meals before sleep.
Create a calm, dark sleeping environment.
Insomnia.disclaimer: ⚠️ Persistent insomnia may indicate underlying health issues. Consult a doctor if it continues.

Obesity.description: Obesity is excess body fat that increases the risk of chronic diseases.
prevention: Avoid junk food and sugary drinks.
Obesity.disclaimer: ⚠️ Obesity requires lifestyle management and sometimes medical support.

Depression.description: Depression is a mental health disorder causing persistent sadness and loss of interest.
Depression.disclaimer: ⚠️ If experiencing suicidal thoughts, seek immediate professional help.

Acidity.description: Acidity occurs when the stomach produces excess acid, leading to heartburn and discomfort.
prevention: Do not lie down immediately after meals.
Acidity.disclaimer: ⚠️ Chronic acidity may indicate underlying digestive issues. Consult a doctor if frequent.

Toothache.description: Toothache is pain in or around a tooth, often due to cavities or infection.
first_aid: Rinse mouth with warm salt water.
Apply a cold compress on the cheek.
Toothache.disclaimer: ⚠️ Persistent tooth pain requires dental evaluation.

Sprain.description: A sprain is a stretched or torn ligament, often in the ankle or wrist.
first_aid: Follow RICE method: Rest, Ice, Compression, Elevation.
Avoid putting weight on the injury.
Sprain.disclaimer: ⚠️ Severe sprains may need medical attention or physiotherapy.

Nosebleed.description: Nosebleeds occur when tiny blood vessels in the nose break due to dryness, injury, or irritation.
first_aid: Sit upright and lean forward slightly.
Apply a cold compress on the nose.
prevention: Use a humidifier in dry weather.
Nosebleed.disclaimer: ⚠️ Frequent or heavy nosebleeds need medical evaluation.

Constipation.description: Constipation is difficulty passing stools or infrequent bowel movements.
Constipation.disclaimer: ⚠️ Chronic constipation may indicate digestive issues. Seek medical advice if persistent.

Acne.description: Acne is a common skin condition where hair follicles get clogged with oil and dead skin cells.

Cough.description: Coughing helps clear the throat and airways, often caused by infections or irritation.
first_aid: Drink warm fluids like ginger tea.
prevention: Avoid exposure to smoke and dust.
Strengthen immunity with a balanced diet.
Cough.disclaimer: ⚠️ Persistent cough for more than 2 weeks should be checked by a doctor.

Diarrhea.description: Diarrhea is frequent, loose, or watery bowel movements, often due to infection or food poisoning.
first_aid: Eat light meals like rice and bananas.
Diarrhea.disclaimer: ⚠️ Severe diarrhea can cause dehydration. Consult a doctor if prolonged.

Ear Pain.description: Ear pain may be due to infection, wax build-up, or pressure changes.
first_aid: Use a warm compress on the ear.
Avoid inserting objects into the ear.
Ear Pain.disclaimer: ⚠️ Persistent or severe ear pain should be checked by an ENT specialist.

Motion Sickness.description: Motion sickness is nausea caused by traveling in cars, boats, or planes.
first_aid: Sit in a comfortable position facing forward.
prevention: Choose seats with less motion (front seat in cars, near wings in planes).
Keep windows open for fresh air.
Motion Sickness.disclaimer: ⚠️ Severe or frequent motion sickness may need medical advice.

Chickenpox.description: Chickenpox is a viral infection causing itchy rash and red spots.
first_aid: Apply calamine lotion to reduce itching.
Keep fingernails short to prevent scratching.
Chickenpox.disclaimer: ⚠️ Consult a doctor if rash spreads extensively or fever is high.

Measles.description: Measles is a highly contagious viral infection causing rash, cough, and fever.
first_aid: Isolate from others to prevent spread.
Measles.disclaimer: ⚠️ Seek medical attention immediately if severe symptoms appear.

Malaria.description: Malaria is a mosquito-borne infectious disease caused by Plasmodium parasites.
prevention: Eliminate stagnant water near living areas.
Malaria.disclaimer: ⚠️ Malaria can be life-threatening; always consult a doctor.

Dengue.description: Dengue is a viral infection transmitted by mosquitoes, causing high fever and body pain.
first_aid: Use paracetamol for pain; avoid aspirin.
Dengue.disclaimer: ⚠️ Severe dengue can cause complications; medical supervision is required.

Typhoid.description: Typhoid is a bacterial infection causing fever, weakness, and abdominal pain.
Typhoid.disclaimer: ⚠️ Typhoid can be serious; always follow doctor’s instructions.

Tuberculosis.description: Tuberculosis (TB) is a bacterial infection affecting the lungs and sometimes other organs.
prevention: Avoid close contact with TB patients.
Tuberculosis.disclaimer: ⚠️ TB requires long-term treatment; do not self-medicate.

Pneumonia.description: Pneumonia is a lung infection causing inflammation of air sacs.
Pneumonia.disclaimer: ⚠️ Pneumonia can be life-threatening, especially in children and elderly.

Gastritis.description: Gastritis is inflammation of the stomach lining, often causing pain and indigestion.
Gastritis.disclaimer: ⚠️ Persistent gastritis should be evaluated by a doctor.

Ulcers.description: Ulcers are sores in the lining of the stomach or small intestine.
Ulcers.disclaimer: ⚠️ Consult a doctor if pain is severe or persistent.

Irritable Bowel Syndrome.description: IBS is a digestive disorder causing abdominal pain and altered bowel habits.
Irritable Bowel Syndrome.disclaimer: ⚠️ Persistent symptoms should be evaluated by a healthcare professional.

Hypothyroidism.description: Hypothyroidism occurs when the thyroid gland produces insufficient hormones.
first_aid: Consult a doctor for thyroid hormone therapy.
Hypothyroidism.disclaimer: ⚠️ Only a doctor can diagnose and treat thyroid conditions.

Hyperthyroidism.description: Hyperthyroidism occurs when the thyroid gland produces excessive hormones.
first_aid: Consult a doctor for proper treatment.
Hyperthyroidism.disclaimer: ⚠️ Only a doctor can diagnose and treat thyroid conditions.

PCOS.description: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) is a hormonal disorder in women causing irregular periods and cysts.
first_aid: Maintain a healthy diet and exercise.
PCOS.disclaimer: ⚠️ PCOS requires medical supervision and lifestyle management.

Conjunctivitis.description: Conjunctivitis, or pink eye, is inflammation of the eye's conjunctiva, often due to infection or allergies.
prevention: Do not share towels or eye makeup.
Conjunctivitis.disclaimer: ⚠️ Persistent or severe cases require medical attention.

Ear Infection.description: Ear infections occur when bacteria or viruses infect the middle ear.
first_aid: Consult a doctor for antibiotics if bacterial.
Avoid inserting objects into the ear.
Ear Infection.disclaimer: ⚠️ Persistent or severe ear infections require medical evaluation.
